text: When one writes $E_r^{p,q}\Rightarrow H^{p+q}$, what does the $E_\infty$ page actually compute about the target $H^n$?
choices: $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}$, the associated graded of a filtration
$H^{p+q}\cong\bigoplus_p E_\infty^{p,q}$ as a direct sum, always
explanation: Convergence recovers only the associated graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}$, never $H^{p+q}$ 'on the nose', because reassembling those pieces into $H^n$ is a possibly nontrivial extension problem. That same extension problem is exactly why $H^n$ need not split as $\bigoplus_p E_\infty^{p,q}$, and $E_2$ is only the input page, generally altered by later differentials.
